attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page says only that the holy Paul the physician died in peace, and gives no country, no century and no year, so he is told from the corpus's many Pauls by the day alone, which is why the slug and the display name carry it; none of them is kept on 28 June in any calendar. The calling the day's line gives him, «ο ιατρός», is recorded in `types` as physician rather than inside the display name, which the naming contract keeps clear of ranks. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
